name: Oinos Aimatos (Thaumaturgy (Path of the Vine of Dionysus), Advanced)

system.description: By spending a Blood Trait and a Willpower Trait, the thaumaturge transforms her own vitae into a potent elixir; for the rest of the scene, anyone who imbibes even a drop is affected as per Enthousiasmos, and the thaumaturge may affect any number of victims without further cost. The tainted blood can only be detected via Heightened Senses and a successful Mental Challenge, or by enhanced taste (usually too late). Kindred who begin this path automatically lose one permanent Willpower Trait as they become addicted to its hedonistic pleasures. This path retests with the Occult Ability.
system.discipline: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Vine of Dionysus)
